import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Parse ICS file and extract events
def parse_ics(filename):
    events = []
    with open(filename, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Extract VEVENT blocks
    event_pattern = re.compile(r'BEGIN:VEVENT(.*?)END:VEVENT', re.DOTALL)
    for match in event_pattern.finditer(content):
        event_block = match.group(1)
        
        # Extract DTSTART and DTEND
        dtstart_match = re.search(r'DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        dtend_match = re.search(r'DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        
        if dtstart_match and dtend_match:
            dtstart_str = dtstart_match.group(1)
            dtend_str = dtend_match.group(1)
            
            dtstart = datetime.strptime(dtstart_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            dtend = datetime.strptime(dtend_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            
            events.append({'start': dtstart, 'end': dtend})
    
    return events

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Best slot: Wednesday, January 17, 2024 at 11:00 AM
meeting_start = datetime(2024, 1, 17, 11, 0, 0)
meeting_end = meeting_start + timedelta(hours=1)

# Generate ICS file
ics_content = """BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH

BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117-110000@example.com
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Team planning meeting with Alice, Bob, and Carol
LOCATION:Conference Room A
ORGANIZER:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:carol@example.com
END:VEVENT

END:VCALENDAR
"""

# Write to file
with open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics', 'w') as f:
